structured.feedback: The prompt requires clearly distinguishing features from benefits and explaining how the product improves the buyer's life, but the response mostly restates usage instructions and never clearly states benefits (e.g., comfort, confidence, gentle daily care). It also drops the 4-10 day usage duration and offers thin SEO beyond the product name.
